title: Tool calling broken with Google Gemini in ai@4.0.34 onwards

linked_prs.title: fix (ai/core): switch to json schema 7 target for zod to json schema conversion
linked_prs.body:
## Background
Switching to `target: 'openAi'` in the zod to json schema conversion caused regressions in the json and openapi schemas that we generate.

Fixes #4412
Fixes #4411
